flashcard_questions.q: The belief that all human life is sacred and God-given, and therefore must be protected and valued from conception to natural death.
The extent to which a person’s life is comfortable, meaningful and free from suffering, sometimes used to argue that ending a life of extreme suffering is compassionate.
The deliberate ending of a pregnancy, usually before the foetus is 24 weeks old, legal in England, Scotland and Wales under certain conditions.

flashcard_questions.a: The principle that an action with a good aim (e.g. saving the mother) can be right even if it has an unintended bad effect (e.g. the foetus dies).
In Islamic teaching, the moment at which the soul is believed to enter the foetus, traditionally held to be at 120 days (approximately 17 weeks) of pregnancy.
